lines.text: 2 days to GTA 6: Take-Two bets $8 billion on you.
lines.say: Two days to GTA Six: Take-Two bets eight billion dollars on you.

lines.text: Last quarter, before GTA 6, they brought in $1.6 billion. Down 18 percent.
lines.say: Last quarter, before GTA Six, they brought in one point six billion dollars. Down eighteen percent.

lines.text: For the full year, they still promised investors at least $8 billion.
lines.say: For the full year, they still promised investors at least eight billion dollars.

lines.text: And for the quarter GTA 6 launches in, up to $3.5 billion. More than double.
lines.say: And for the quarter GTA Six launches in, up to three and a half billion. More than double.

lines.text: That gap gets filled at $79.99 a copy. 1 day to go, tomorrow.
lines.say: That gap gets filled at seventy-nine ninety-nine a copy. One day to go, tomorrow.
